description: This file defines the class HTMLPurifier_UnitConverter, which handles unit-length conversions specifically designed for CSS units. It includes methods for converting between units, handling precision, and supporting different measuring systems like English and Metric.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_UnitConverter
classes.description: A class for converting between different CSS measurement units, supporting various measuring systems with precision management.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the UnitConverter with specified precision settings and determines BCMath availability.

methods.name: convert
methods.description: Converts a length object from one unit to another, maintaining precision and supporting multiple systems.

methods.name: getSigFigs
methods.description: Calculates the number of significant figures in a decimal number string.
